note: THE QUOIN, POST-MERGE SWEEP: two items had NO committed home and are recorded here so they survive worktree teardown. Found by asking a reviewer the one question a diff review cannot answer -- what did NOT survive -- which this repo already learned from The Ell (nine items promoted, six still lost). 21 items checked, 19 landed, 2 did not. ONE: A BACKGROUNDED BASH COMMAND SILENTLY RESETS THE SESSION WORKING DIRECTORY, and the reset is announced once at launch, not when it bites. make prewarm was launched in the background early in this campaign. Many turns later a git add resolved against the MAIN checkout instead of the worktree and failed loudly -- pathspec did not match -- while a cat append to the campaign decision ledger SUCCEEDED SILENTLY, creating a stray campaign ledger in main ignored scratch. The asymmetry is the lesson: the failing command told me immediately, the succeeding one wrote campaign state into another checkout with no signal at all, and a stray ledger in a shared scratch is exactly what CLAUDE.md warns hands the next campaign a previous one decisions, reading as its own. Damage was contained because .superpowers is gitignored and main tracked tree stayed clean. THE GENERALISATION, which is what makes it worth keeping: a compound cd X and-and ... anchors ONE call, not a session. Use git -C PATH and absolute paths for anything that WRITES, whenever a backgrounded command may have run earlier in the session. Re-anchoring per-call is not enough if something else can reset cwd between calls. TWO: A PARKED TEST GAP. No discourse test exercises a vowel-initial subject word, so definiteness_prefix an-branch is unexercised at the realize_common_discourse call site in domains/language/src/clause.rs. Pre-existing rather than introduced, and not live -- make rebaseline regenerates every almanac and gallery page over real worlds and byte-matches -- but untested. earth is a registered vowel-initial concept, so the fix is one test.
